page.overview:
Who is Aalbort?

Formerly: member of the crew of Principle of Reasonable Interest

After somebody snuck a Dimensional Randomizer into the hold by listing it as "Robot Parts", it activated during an explosion opening a portal to another dimension, allowing the warlord Azunbulxibar and his troops to invade. Aalbort help defend the ship alongside the only other survivor, the ship's captain. The captain temporarily trapped the invading force when Starfox and Heater Delight discovered Aalbort. Eros asked Aalbort to lower the shield so he could talk to Azunbulxibar, which he reluctantly did. Eros was successful in duping the bellicose Azunbulxibar and his troops into returning to their own dimension.
